newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end light trade mixed.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end light trade mixed.

text.p: April 17 - IMM currency futures ended light afternoon trading mixed. Action picked up near the close, as fund bought another 1,000 June Swiss/sold marks. The fund also sold 1,200 Canadian dollar/bought Aussie dollar in spreads. June Mexican peso hit new contract high, lifted more as a bank bought 300 late. Brokers cited capital flows into M peso, possibly for tax purposes. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
